card.name: End of drug name before a verb
card.fires_on: The last word or piece of a drug or product name (such as tablets, injection, capsules, or the end of a brand name) when it is the subject and a verb or 'and/or' comes next, in label warnings and interaction text.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: A form word like tablets, capsules or injection closes a drug name that is the subject of a clause.

card.writes: It seems to prepare for a following clause about cause or consequence (such as 'because' or 'causing'), rather than more name pieces.
card.plain: It marks the end of a drug or product name, right where the sentence is about to say what happens next.
